title: Amplitude definition
text: The amplitude is the distance between the midline and the maximum value.

title: Compute amplitude
text: The amplitude is $$1-(-2)=3$$. \n We could also compute by looking at the maximum minus the minimum and dividing by 2: \n $$\frac{1-\left(-5\right)}{2}=\frac{6}{2}=3$$
